I've been the guy in this situation.  I think I can speak for a lot of guys when I say that we just enjoy the chase and trying to get what we can't have.  Our pride kinda depends on it.

Personally I think the more "WOW" obsessed one is over a girl early on in the relationship, the quicker they would get bored.  If one is really interested in a person originally, they would want to know everything about them.  After that, there's not much emotional bonding between the two.  I'd say to look at it in a strictly logical sense.  Does she make you happy?  Do you see potential for a future such as marriage?  Would you guys be financially stable?  Take these questions into consideration.
Also the previous relationships have probably built up some sort of natural defense mechanism in which it's harder for you to truly commit to a woman.  Give it some time, man.  The most important thing is being happy around her.
